address: Politiebureau Oost Zeeburg, Atje Keulen-Deelstrastraat 2, Amsterdam (IJburg/Zeeburgereiland)
notes: 2022 police bureau, a 45 m long rounded block (3DBAG panels 14 and 27) with a recessed upper level. Only the south-east long front (panel 14, surfaces 15 and 17) is described, from the 2025-09-25 panorama (front-alt.jpg) and the 2022 panorama thumbnail: light grey-brown brick, three storeys, white string courses, an upper band of tall windows, a middle band of small windows, and POLITIE lettered in blue on the wall (gold flame emblem not modelled). The lettering sits at about 55-70 % of the front in the panorama; the kit centres wall lettering over the entrance, so in the model it is above the glazed left-hand entrance end instead (position deviation, kept so the kit is exercised on a real wall).

The ground storey of this front is mostly a dark green ivy-clad wall (blank), with glazing only at the south-west curved end and tall glazed slots rising through the lower two storeys near the middle; the slots and the entrance end are not modelled (flat bay grid), so the ground is left blank.
No striped band, blue lamp, canopy or garage doors are visible on this front; police components are not used.
The north-west long wall (panel 27), the curved ends and the recessed upper level (panels 9, 13) have no panorama in the cache and are left to otherWalls (blank).
